program.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Change the image into pencil drawing
requirements.source_phrase: Change the image into pencil drawing

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.

nodes.question: Has the image been changed into a pencil drawing?
nodes.criteria: complete: the image is fully rendered as a pencil drawing; partial: some requested pencil-drawing transformation is evident but the image is not fully rendered as one; absent: no requested transformation is evident; unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Unrelated edits do not count.
nodes.binding: Target: the image. Reference: pencil drawing.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.

flat.reason: The sole check directly covers the requested image transformation, preserves the target and pencil-drawing reference, and distinguishes complete, partial, absent, and unknown without adding constraints. No applicability or dependency blocks or routing inferences are present.

tree.reason: The sole check directly covers the requested image transformation, preserves the target and pencil-drawing reference, and distinguishes complete, partial, absent, and unknown without adding constraints. No routing or inferences alter the check.
